September noun

classical

Cic. Att. 6.2.10: mēnse Septembrī
Cic. Att. 1.1.2: mēnse Septembrī (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 77

September, Septembris, Septembre

adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis), declension

of September; September

The seventh month, counting from March (septem; Varro, LL 6.34). Ablative Septembrī; Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Septembrēs: the 1st, 5th and 13th.

Examples

  • ego mē spērō Athēnīs fore mēnse Septembrī

    I hope to be in Athens in SeptemberCic. Att. 6.2.10

See also month, August, October, autumn.
